retrieval_policy: 23 unique initial URLs, one GET invocation each, three-worker maximum, curl 20-second deadline/10MB cap, no authenticated broker API. Curl followed public redirects where reported. No repeated URL, no date brute force. Search responses only discovery; no search snippet used as evidence.

sources.what_it_proves: Public SmartAPI docs: tradable-instrument master is updated daily and daily downloads are recommended. Historical candle documentation requires exchange/token/interval/fromdate/todate.
sources.what_it_does_not_prove: No historical expired-master archive or date-indexed complete listing interface was established. Daily update is not proof of historical publication or token continuity. Do not claim such archives cannot exist privately.
